# Vendor diagnostic fixture

sunxi-opp-original.c preserves the OPP diagnostic callback from the pinned official Orange Pi kernel source at commit 2ac08e8c7cdc28abbdc5c9a9dd812f887ae9c79f, bsp/modules/gpu/img-bxm/linux/rogue_km/services/system/rogue/rgx_sunxi/sunxi_platform.c. Original Allwinner copyright and GPL-2.0-or-later notice are retained. GPL-2 is provided here. The fixture is for regression compilation only and is not installed in the image.
